name: sheffield-bill
intent: Buy the best-value house in south Sheffield: cheap against its fundamentals (space, layout, 3 beds), front door into a hall, room to extend out or up. Refurb it fully while renting elsewhere, then live in it. Works budget up to about £250k from family loans.

vibe.summary: Young-professional, characterful period house (Victorian/Edwardian bay terrace or 1930s semi), walkable to a big park and an independent high street, owner-occupied streets. Not a suburban estate, not a student area.
likes: independent high street (Abbeydale Rd, Chesterfield Rd, Sharrow Vale, Crookes Rd)
avoid: very steep streets with no parking

record: scope to extend or convert loft

gates.text: In one of the search areas above.
Asking at most {price_max}; asking + 1.15W + C at most {allin_max}.
Freehold, or lease of 150+ years with no live covenant dispute.
No movement, subsidence, knotweed, spray foam, non-standard build or dry rot.

Front door opens into a hall, lobby or porch, never straight into a living, reception or dining room or kitchen. Fail if the listing text or floorplan shows it opens into a room, even if a hall could be made later. If neither shows where it opens, pass as unconfirmed and name it in the risk.

finished_spec: 3 real bedrooms (two of 11.5 m2+), kitchen-diner of 25 m2+ at the back, separate sitting room, front door into a hall, 90-110 m2 inside.

buy_test.tax_note: Stamp duty as a first-time buyer: nil up to £300k, 5% from £300k to £500k.
buy_test.comps_sources: Rightmove sold prices, Zoopla, Land Registry via domovita / housemetric / propertyengine / doogal; Housemetric joins EPC floor areas to sales

criteria.name: Extension headroom (garden ≥ 10 m; loft fits; neighbours extended)
Street quality (owner-occupied, tidy fronts, few letting boards, no main road or rat-run)
Inside bones (light, ceiling height, period features, scope to open up)
Outside (stone or good brick, bay, front garden, terrace hangs together)

sources.name: Rightmove
sources.desc: Rightmove (rightmove.co.uk), the biggest UK portal. Listing pages look like rightmove.co.uk/properties/<number>; sold-STC, under-offer and auction tags show on the page. WebFetch often refuses these pages: find the same house on Zoopla, OnTheMarket, PrimeLocation, the agent's site or a Rightmove brochure PDF (media.rightmove.co.uk).

sources.name: Zoopla
sources.desc: Zoopla (zoopla.co.uk; also app.zoopla.co.uk and primelocation.com, which share stock). Listing pages look like zoopla.co.uk/for-sale/details/<number>; they often show £/sq ft and floor area.

sources.name: OnTheMarket
sources.desc: OnTheMarket (onthemarket.com). Listing pages look like onthemarket.com/details/<number>.

sources.name: Jitty
sources.desc: Jitty (jitty.com), an AI portal that tags listings with floor area, £/sq ft and condition (Renovation Potential, Renovation Needed). Search pages live under jitty.com/for-sale/... and are indexed by web search. Prefer houses tagged as needing renovation, but return every qualifying house.

sources.desc: BTG Eddisons Property Auctions (btgeddisonspropertyauctions.com), incl. Mark Jenkinson and SDL. Sheffield office page btgeddisonspropertyauctions.com/offices/sheffield. Upcoming lots only. Price = guide. Add flag auction.
